title: Approve core business rules
decision: Adopt the rules marked 'decided here' in docs/05-domain-model/OUTPUT.md: running-balance accounts with calculated oldest-first allocation, acknowledgement only for debt-increasing entries, no dispute after confirmation, disputed amounts excluded from reminders, whole-entry reversal only, and removal of customer data deferred until the balance is zero
context: The PRD left several rules open (its open questions 3, 5 and 6) that must be fixed before architecture; these rules shape what owners and customers experience and how data is stored
chosen_option: Rules as written in the domain model
rationale: Keeps the ledger immutable and simple (EVID-017), keeps disputes from inflating reminders, and avoids stored allocations that would complicate reversals; the removal rule rests on an untested reading of the personal data law (EVID-027)
